description: This source file implements the prach_generator_impl class, which generates PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) sequences for 3GPP LTE/NR systems. It includes functions for generating long and short preamble sequences, managing cyclic shifts, and sequence number calculations based on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: prach_generator_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for generating PRACH sequences, including methods for sequence number calculation and sequence generation for LTE/NR preambles.

methods.name: get_sequence_number_long
methods.description: Calculates the long sequence number based on the root sequence index, using a lookup table.

methods.name: get_sequence_number_short
methods.description: Calculates the short sequence number based on the root sequence index, using a lookup table.

methods.name: generate_y_u_v_long
methods.description: Generates a long PRACH sequence with specified sequence number and cyclic shift.

methods.name: generate_y_u_v_short
methods.description: Generates a short PRACH sequence with specified sequence number and cyclic shift.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main function to generate PRACH sequences based on configuration, handling long and short preambles.
